symbols.name: input bit length
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each of the two binary inputs of the multiplier.
symbols.quote: The established $O(n\log n)$ multiplier (also called the Harvey–van der Hoeven multiplier) solves [exact integer multiplication](exact-integer-multiplication.md) on pairs of $N$-bit inputs, where $N$ is the number of bits in each input, in $O(N\log N)$ time.
